CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.OFFL_PicoLogASWpis(@pckid int,@info varchar(64),@komunikat varchar(200)) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON declare @maxID int declare @commitFlag int
set @commitFlag = 0
begin transaction while 1=1 begin select @maxID=ISNULL(MAX(PcL_ObiNumer),0) from CDN.PicoLog with(tablock) where PcL_PcKID=@pckid and PcL_ObiTyp=0 if @@error<>0 break set @maxID = @maxID + 1
insert into CDN.PicoLog (PcL_PcKID,PcL_ObiTyp,PcL_ObiNumer,PcL_ObiektID,PcL_Komentarz,PcL_Info) values (@pckid,0,@maxID,0,@komunikat,@info) if @@error<>0 break
set @commitFlag = 1
break end if @commitFlag = 1 commit else rollback
SET NOCOUNT OFF select @commitFlag end
